system.description: Some Cappadocians bear the strange gift of foresight, though their revelations are brief and dim. Prescience gives little insight of immediate or tactical value, but it does prepare the vampire somewhat for the future — knowing whether an individual can be trusted, recognizing an object of value, or any other effect the Storyteller allows for the sake of the story. The exact nature and timing of a character's premonitions are decided by the Storyteller. It is worth noting that these visions are not "possible futures"; they are murky, vague fragments of a definite time to come.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
